items.raw_excerpt: When seeking Swiss naturalisation, you must provide certain documents. One of them is a reference letter.
items.summary_en: When you apply for Swiss citizenship, you must submit certain documents. One of them is a reference letter. This article explains what that letter is and why you may need it.

items.raw_excerpt: The Gordie Howe International Bridge officially opened to traffic on Monday, but trucks continue to crowd Huron Church Road. Industry leader says it will be a while before traffic patterns change.
items.summary_en: The new Gordie Howe International Bridge opened to traffic on Monday. Trucks still crowd Huron Church Road near the old crossing. Industry leaders say traffic patterns will take time to change.
items.summary_ko: 새 고디 하우 국제 다리가 월요일에 개통했지만, 휴런 처치 로드에는 여전히 트럭이 줄지어 있다. 업계 관계자는 교통 흐름이 바뀌기까지는 시간이 걸릴 것이라고 말했다.
items.title_en: New bridge, same traffic: Road to Ambassador Bridge still packed with trucks

items.title_original: New bridge, same traffic: Why is the road to the Ambassador Bridge still packed with trucks?

items.raw_excerpt: Praia da Falésia is one of the most interesting beaches on the coast.
items.summary_en: Praia da Falesia is one of the most interesting beaches on the coast of Portugal. It sits in the Algarve region, a favorite place for many visitors. People love its long stretch of sand and clear water.
items.summary_ko: 프라이아 다 팔레시아는 포르투갈 해안에서 가장 흥미로운 해변 중 하나입니다. 알가르브 지역에 있으며 많은 방문객이 좋아하는 곳입니다. 길게 펼쳐진 모래와 맑은 바닷물이 매력적입니다.
items.title_en: Praia da Falesia: the greatest beach in the Algarve

items.title_original: The greatest Praia da Falésia in the Algarve

items.raw_excerpt: AfriForum campaigns officer, Louis Boshoff says the changes are not yet in effect
items.summary_en: South Africa plans to extend the validity of driving licence cards. AfriForum welcomed the change. The rules are not in effect yet.

items.raw_excerpt: Uisce Éireann has said it is "well prepared" as it is due to carry out its largest ever repair this weekend.
items.summary_en: Uisce Éireann says it is well prepared for its largest ever repair. The repair will take place this weekend. It will be the biggest repair the Irish water company has ever done.
items.summary_ko: Uisce Éireann은 이번 주말에 진행될 역대 최대 규모의 수리에 대비를 잘 갖추고 있다고 밝혔습니다. 이번 수리는 아일랜드 수도회사가 진행한 수리 중 가장 큰 규모가 될 것입니다.
items.title_en: Uisce Éireann ready for biggest ever repair

items.raw_excerpt: Este antiguo pueblo ferroviario del sur cordobés conserva estaciones, construcciones y recuerdos de una época de esplendor que todavía despiertan la curiosidad de viajeros, fotógrafos y amantes de los destinos poco convencionales.
items.summary_en: This old railway town in southern Córdoba keeps its stations, buildings, and memories of a splendid past. It still draws curious travelers, photographers, and lovers of unusual places.
items.summary_ko: 코르도바 남부에 있는 이 옛 철도 마을은 화려했던 시절의 역과 건물, 추억을 그대로 간직하고 있다. 여전히 여행자와 사진가, 색다른 여행지를 사랑하는 사람들의 호기심을 자극한다.
items.title_en: Silent Historic Town in Córdoba Has Just Two Residents

items.title_original: Silencioso, histórico y con apenas dos habitantes: el pueblo de Córdoba que ofrece una tranquilidad difícil de encontrar - Canal26
